releaseNotes:
Work Station: separate employee attendance login/logout with three Dhaka shifts.
Eight-hour timer excluding breaks, shortfall, early-leave reasons and overtime.
Daily checklist in the app: blog, news portal and LinkedIn for morning shift.
Employee daily/weekly/monthly/yearly records, shift activity timeline and CSV exports.
Separate Windows/extension health, refresh gaps and targets. Requires the updated server database and extension 0.2.0.
